diagonalWasteAdderByType.laminate.label: Diagonal additional waste by flooring type
diagonalWasteAdderByType.laminate.source: Word of Mouth Floors lists diagonal or herringbone total waste at 12–14% for laminate, 10–12% for luxury vinyl plank, 15–17% for solid hardwood and about 15% for large tile. Source: https://www.wordofmouthfloors.com/blogs/flooring/how-much-extra-flooring-should-you-order-waste-factor
diagonalWasteAdderByType.laminate.assumption: Add 6 percentage points for laminate, 4 for vinyl plank, 7 for hardwood and 3 for tile to your saved straight-lay waste. With straight-lay waste of 8%, 8%, 10% and 12%, these reach the published upper totals of 14%, 12%, 17% and 15%. Your own straight-lay value stays unchanged; the same additions are assumed for diagonal, herringbone and chevron.
